title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, lets identical disposable /wc chats form a rolling self-organizing production pool under scoped authority, learns which worker protocol patterns actually produce durable value, compounds useful output with decreasing human coordination, and guarantees every replacement /g inherits, acts on, and writes back the active mission rather than reconstructing it shallowly.
human_goal: The human can keep launching the exact same POOL PROD-01 /wc prompt and intentionally forget this chat. Workers should self-assign/chain/assist/verify/integrate across all grounded projects without numbering, manual routing, cohort waits or result transport. When the human later opens a fresh /g, that Guide must recover Current Mission + current live evidence, execute safe high-value corrections, persist writeback, and never make the human explain the lost conversation.
success_conditions: Fresh /g recovers ACTIVE_BINDING Current Mission without transcript or old-chat lookup.
Fresh /g loads current GRW001/runtime/frontier/worker-scoreboard before strategic claims about pool state.
Fresh /g executes safe useful mission work and persists material writeback/session receipt before replying when not blocked.
Bare /g has no arbitrary one-action cap; it continues same-turn grounded guide work until real boundary/exhaustion/context limit.
Rolling POOL PROD-01 remains the default production model; normal evaluation does not impose cohort barriers.
Workers treat productive unit 3 as checkpoint, target 6, hard cap 8, and may expose at most two non-overlapping assist children for safe long work.
Terminal pool workers write evidence-backed exam cards; Live does not treat premature CLOSE without exam as terminal.
Champion protocol behavior is propagated only after >=3 independent workers reproduce score >=8/10; verbosity never increases score.
Useful durable results, breadth, reproduction and visible product changes improve relative to human intervention; raw chat count alone is never success.
Project-specific SOURCE_DEBT/capability/authority boundaries remain respected and are not reopened as filler.
Routine planning/integration/rescate remains distributed; /g is not the human's manual scheduler or result courier.
Candidate, Verified, Promoted, Current, Human Accepted and Served remain distinct.
Production /w remains evidence-gated until current stress/critic/multi-surface/metabolism criteria pass.
A genuine fresh /g canary proves the new Current Mission/writeback extension without human reconstruction; core succession itself is already verified.
current_frontier: ACTIVE_BINDING CONTINUOUS_POOL-01 with S3_JOB_CLASS_STRATEGIES now active. YIELD-10X-V1 failed independent reproduction and is retired as a universal worker pattern: fresh scoreboard 2026-09-18T18:54:44.913Z has 48 exam cards, 20 tagged YIELD-10X workers (19 v3.27), 0 tagged scores >=8, tagged max 5, no tagged visible changes, 6 successor-reproducing workers, 3 with product breadth >=4, 61 collisions and 16 no-allocation events. Preserve component evidence and test narrower job-class strategies; do not infer current occupancy from the stale runtime projection.
next_human_action: No recap, routing, merging or result transport is required. External /wc invocation is still the known wake mechanism if more worker execution is desired now; unattended wake remains UNPROVEN and no numeric launch count is justified from stale occupancy.
authority_law: Workers may think broadly but mutate only claimed/authorized scopes. Pool scale, exams, scores, generated jobs, worker returns and Guide roles do not self-promote Human Accepted, Current, Catalog, Lineage or Served authority. A Guide successor cannot infer present truth from historical snapshots; it must load Current Mission and current exact evidence.
update_law: Material changes to the active mission, growth mode, champion protocol, yield bottlenecks, project state, method/invariants, authority boundaries, queues/claims/returns or Guide succession must be persisted to the narrowest canonical durable object plus a Guide session receipt when operating a bare /g cycle.
current_mission_handoff_truth: A genuinely fresh /g again loaded Current Mission/current evidence, acted materially and wrote back without human reconstruction. Core succession + Current Mission handoff are VERIFIED; unattended self-wake and production /w remain separate unproven/gated claims.
